Package com.im.njams.sdk.model

Class ActivityMapping.Builder

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.model.ActivityMapping.Builder
  • Enclosing class:
    ActivityMapping
    public static final class ActivityMapping.Builder
extends Object
    Fluent builder for constructing a mapping tree node by node. Sibling nodes are added by chaining leaf(String, Object) and branch(String, Consumer) on the same builder; a branch's children are populated through the Consumer passed to branch(String, Consumer).

    • Method Detail

      • leaf

        public ActivityMapping.Builder leaf​(String name,
                                    Object value)
        Adds a leaf node (a name with a value) to the current level. The value is rendered as its string representation; null becomes an empty string.
        Parameters:
        name - the leaf label
        value - the leaf value; may be null
        Returns:
        this builder, for chaining further siblings

      • branch

        public ActivityMapping.Builder branch​(String name,
                                      Consumer<ActivityMapping.Builder> children)
        Adds a branch node (a name with its own nested entries) to the current level. The given Consumer receives a fresh builder for the branch and should populate its children; branches may be nested to arbitrary depth.
        Parameters:
        name - the branch label
        children - callback that populates the branch's children
        Returns:
        this builder, for chaining further siblings

        Builds the ActivityMapping from the nodes added so far.
